summary: Full e2e test of Review Mode (Draft→In review→Published gate, Owner publish, assignments/comments/verdicts, Review Console) and the editor delete-redirect bug fix. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py). Frontend: primary bug fix VERIFIED for BOTH delete entry points (sidebar trash on unlinked doc row and PageMetaDialog meta-delete-confirm) — URL stayed at /admin/editor/<pid>/<siblingDocId>, never /admin/docs. Editor publish gate (doc-status-pill In review → Publish → Published → Take down → In review), content gate via /api/public/default-project, Review Console role badge/tabs, assignment create + 'Mark done' blocked by unresolved comment then allowed after resolve, Review Inbox resolve, unread badge, Publish tab publish/takedown all PASS. Environment restored to baseline (121 docs, 0 published, 0 comments, 0 assignments, nav config restored from backup).

minor.issue: Delete does not prune the document's slug from project_configs.navigation. Confirmed in UI: after deleting a linked page via PageMetaDialog the sidebar showed a dangling 'untitled-mth54f3l  missing' nav entry (and the public nav would link to a non-existent page). Editor's handleDeleteFromDialog also does not update navConfig.

scope_type='group' matches by group NAME across ALL tabs, so duplicate group names collide. Real data has 'Reference' in 2 tabs → an assignment scoped to one tab's 'Reference' silently pulls in the other tab's pages. Scope should be (tab, group) qualified.
'unread' count never decreases from the console because the UI never calls POST /comments/{cid}/read; the red inbox-badge stays after viewing/resolving (badge still showed 1 after resolve).

ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key' repeated on every render — scopeOptions key `${type}:${id}` is not unique because group name 'Reference' exists in two tabs; selecting it is also ambiguous.
Delete (trash) button and row had no data-testid; added delete-unlinked-<docId> and unlinked-doc-<docId> for testability.

issues: Overview/Assignments/Publish layout, pills and contrast look clean; no contrast/spacing defects found. Publish tab renders all 121 rows unpaginated/unsearchable — usable but heavy for owners.

action_items: Prune the deleted document's slug from navigation config on delete (backend delete_document or Editor handleDeleteFromDialog/handleDeleteDocument) to avoid dangling 'missing' nav entries.

Make review scope ids tab-qualified (e.g. `${tabId}::${group}`) in both ReviewConsole scopeOptions keys and backend flatten_scope_slugs to fix the duplicate React key error and the cross-tab 'Reference' scope collision.
Mark inbox comments read (POST /comments/{cid}/read) when the Review Inbox tab is opened so the unread badge clears.

Minor: Editor handleDeleteFromDialog useCallback deps are [projectId, docId, navigate] but it calls gotoAfterDelete (which depends on `documents`) — stale-closure risk could send the user to /admin/editor/<pid> instead of a sibling; add gotoAfterDelete to the deps.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is 1452 lines — split sidebar/nav tree, toolbar and publish-gate logic into modules.
handleDeleteFromDialog dependency array omits gotoAfterDelete (stale closure over `documents`).
Document delete leaves navigation config inconsistent (orphan slug) — no server-side cleanup or transaction.
flatten_scope_slugs matches groups by name only; not tab-scoped.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (delete redirect x2, publish gate, content gate, review console tabs/assignments/inbox/publish)

seed_data_creation: Temp docs TEST_TrashDelete/TEST_TrashDelete2 + one UI-created 'Untitled Page' (all deleted), one seeded unread review comment on talk-it-through and one assignment to test_reviewer@example.com (both deleted). Nav config restored from /tmp/config_backup.json. Verified final state: 121 docs, 0 published, 0 comments, 0 assignments, public documents = 0.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing/empty — not needed, DISABLE_AUTH=true auto-authenticates dev@local as Owner (verified via /api/roles/me and /api/auth/me).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pid=d901b4ab-a271-4aff-b63a-bf92d73b9bb0 and doc talk-it-through=f20c76cc-bf77-4d16-bc25-83cd9d29c91f. Editor/console pages need ~10s hydration; never rely on networkidle. For window.confirm flows register page.on('dialog', accept) AND click with no_wait_after=True, otherwise the click promise hangs. PageMetaDialog delete is only reachable from linked nav pages (page-menu-<slug>); create a throwaway page via [data-testid="group-add-page-Get Started"] and restore project config afterwards (PUT /api/projects/{pid}/config). Reviewer(non-owner) UX untested (auth bypass forces Owner); voice comments intentionally untested.
rca_of_the_issue: Primary bug fix confirmed correct: both handleDeleteDocument and handleDeleteFromDialog route through gotoAfterDelete(), which navigates to /admin/editor/<pid>/<siblingId> (or /admin/editor/<pid> when no sibling); no /admin/docs navigation observed in either path. Remaining defects are secondary: nav-config orphan on document delete, tab-unqualified group scope ids (duplicate React key + wrong slug fan-out), and inbox unread badge never cleared.
